name: Floyd
gaps: Parcels are CurrentParcels (Rome-Floyd GIS — as of 6/30/2026) (https://services2.arcgis.com/nV67H1IJR8GS6SAA/arcgis/rest/services/CurrentParcels/FeatureServer/0). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Household income stays the ACS B19013_001E tract join. GDOT AADT is not copied onto the parcel.
Pass 2 sale status is REST, but the live CurrentParcels layer has no sale price or date field, so sale stays empty.
Source query returned 7576 rows; 7575 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 tax is REST, sale is REST, and owner is REST. HTML-only values were not scraped.
Property-appraiser links use each parcel id in the pass-2 template and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
